---
title: Client Intake Form Template
description: YAML template for client intake workflows with conditional follow-up sections.
---

```yaml
version: 1
title: Client Intake Form
description: Collect project requirements and contact details

sections:
  - id: section_1
    title: Intake Basics
    fields:
      - id: client_name
        type: short_text
        label: Client name
        placeholder: Enter name
        validators:
          - required

      - id: contact_email
        type: email
        label: Contact email
        placeholder: name@example.com
        validators:
          - required

      - id: project_type
        type: single_select
        label: Project type
        options:
          - Website
          - Mobile App
          - Other
        validators:
          - required

      - id: budget_range
        type: dropdown
        label: Budget range
        placeholder: Select option
        options:
          - Less than 5,000
          - 5,000 to 20,000
          - 20,000+
        validators:
          - required

      # Optional hidden field for prefilled source tracking.
      # - id: source
      #   type: hidden
      #   label: Source
      #   placeholder: website

    next:
      - when: data.project_type == "Website"
        go: section_2
      - when: data.project_type == "Mobile App"
        go: section_3
      - else: section_4

  - id: section_2
    title: Website Details
    fields:
      - id: website_scope
        type: multiple_select
        label: Scope
        options:
          - Marketing pages
          - Blog
          - CMS
          - Ecommerce
        validators:
          - required

      - id: existing_website
        type: url
        label: Existing website URL
        placeholder: https://example.com
    next: section_4

  - id: section_3
    title: Mobile App Details
    fields:
      - id: target_platforms
        type: multiple_select
        label: Target platforms
        options:
          - iOS
          - Android
          - Both
        validators:
          - required

      - id: app_stage
        type: single_select
        label: Current stage
        options:
          - Idea
          - Prototype
          - Existing app
        validators:
          - required
    next: section_4

  - id: section_4
    title: Project Requirements
    fields:
      - id: project_summary
        type: long_text
        label: Project summary
        placeholder: Describe the project requirements
        validators:
          - required

      - id: attachments
        type: file_upload
        label: Attachments
        placeholder: Upload files
    next: done

completion:
  title: Thank you, {{data.client_name}}!
  message: Your intake form was submitted.
  button:
    label: Return to website
    url: https://example.com

# Optional notifications and integrations.
# connections:
#   - type: email
#     to: team@example.com
#     subject: "New intake - {{form.title}}"
#     include_responses: true
#
#   - type: webhook
#     url: https://example.com/webhook/intake
#
#   - type: airtable
#     connection_id: replace_with_connection_id
#     base_id: replace_with_base_id
#     table_id_or_name: Intake Requests
#
# Optional analytics.
# mixpanel: replace_with_mixpanel_project_token
```
